caption: The drawing depicts a large brown eagle with outstretched wings facing left, positioned centrally above a U.S. shield that is red, white, and blue with white stars on a blue upper section and vertical red and white stripes below. The eagle's beak is open and yellow, and its talons grip the shield and the tops of two crossed blue poles. Draped on either side of the eagle and shield are two large swags of cloth in the pattern of the American flag, featuring red and white stripes and a field of white stars on a dark blue background at each end. Each swag is gathered at the end with a gold cord and tassel and is attached to the ends of the blue poles. The background is plain and uncolored, and in the lower right corner, the name "Francis Powell" is written above "WPA - VA."
title: Sternboard Eagle
